paragraphs.heading: Coverage
paragraphs.text: Acme Health reimburses chronic care management when a care plan is documented.

paragraphs.heading: Limits
paragraphs.text: Chronic care management is limited to 1 per calendar month.

faq.question: Is a care plan required?
faq.answer: Yes. Acme Health requires a documented care plan.

paragraphs.heading: Coverage
paragraphs.text: Acme Health covers acupuncture for chronic low back pain up to 12 sessions per year.

code_table.description: Acupuncture needle insertion each additional 15 minutes
